name: kill-guard
description: Refuses process-killing commands that match the ways this machine has actually been broken
doc: Three rules, each from a real incident. (1) A numeric PID may only be killed when the same command shows it was looked up with `ps -p` first. (2) `pkill -f` must use the bracket trick (`[/]opt/...`) so the pattern cannot match the shell that is running it. (3) systemd, systemd --user, gdm, dbus-daemon and feishu_bridge.py are never killable by name — that one took the whole session down for three hours. Denials are decisions, not suggestions: the tool call does not run.

commands.name: rules
commands.title: Print the three rules
commands.doc: Shows what this mod refuses and why, so a denial is explainable without reading the source.
